metadata.question: Does the urban area extent in Naivasha, Kenya increase from 1986 to 2000?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Naivasha, Kenya (approximately -0.7167°S, 36.4333°E) - Time periods: 1986 (baseline) and 2000 (comparison) - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 5 or 7 for 2000 - Need to calculate urban area extent for both periods 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate urban area measurements - Use cloud masking functions appropriate for Landsat - Urban areas can be identified using NDVI (low values) and NDBI (high values) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If urban area calculation returns 0, this could be valid (no urban area detected) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: If urban area increases from 1986 to 2000 - B: If urban area stays same or decreases ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time periods const naivasha = ee.Geometry.Point([36.4333, -0.7167]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius // 2. Cloud masking function for Landsat 5 function maskL5Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 3. Function to calculate urban area using NDBI and NDVI function calculateUrban(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); // Urban: NDBI > 0 and NDVI < 0.2 const urban = ndbi.gt(0).and(ndvi.lt(0.2)); return urban; } // 4. Get 1986 data (Landsat 5) let col1986 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(naivasha) .filterDate('1986-01-01', '1986-12-31') .map(maskL5Clouds); const size1986 = await col1986.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images: ${size1986}`); if (size1986 === 0) { console.log('No data for 1986'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get 2000 data (Landsat 5 or 7) let col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(naivasha) .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .map(maskL5Clouds); let size2000 = await col2000.size().getInfo(); if (size2000 === 0) { col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(naivasha) .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .map(maskL5Clouds); size2000 = await col2000.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`2000 Images: ${size2000}`); if (size2000 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2000'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Create median composites const img1986 = col1986.median(); const img2000 = col2000.median(); // 7. Calculate urban areas const urban1986 = calculateUrban(img1986); const urban2000 = calculateUrban(img2000); // 8. Calculate pixel counts const stats1986 = await urban1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: naivasha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2000 = await urban2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: naivasha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const urbanCount1986 = stats1986.NDVI_sum || 0; const totalCount1986 = stats1986.NDVI_count || 0; const urbanCount2000 = stats2000.NDVI_sum || 0; const totalCount2000 = stats2000.NDVI_count || 0; console.log(`1986 Valid Pixels: ${totalCount1986}, Urban: ${urbanCount1986}`); console.log(`2000 Valid Pixels: ${totalCount2000}, Urban: ${urbanCount2000}`); if (totalCount1986 === 0 || totalCount2000 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (urbanCount1986 === null || urbanCount2000 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Compare urban areas const urbanArea1986 = urbanCount1986 * 9; // 3000m scale = 9 km²/pixel const urbanArea2000 = urbanCount2000 * 9; console.log(`Urban Area 1986: ${urbanArea1986.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Urban Area 2000: ${urbanArea2000.toFixed(2)} km²`); if (urbanArea2000 > urbanArea1986) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
